headline: Quieter, a smarter ring, one volume, and it tells you what's new

items.title: Quiet when idle
items.text: The Q sleeps deeper when nothing plays, and USB audio naps through the silence your TV sends.

items.title: One volume everywhere
items.text: Spotify, AirPlay, the app, the dome and Home Assistant all move the same volume.

items.title: A ring that follows the day
items.text: The ring dims with the daylight, switches off on a schedule, and fades smoothly.

items.title: Your settings stay
items.text: The name, theme, services, EQ and MQTT setup survive a reflash.

items.title: Update alerts
items.text: The Q checks for new releases by itself, and the app tells you what's new.
